history.summary: Very compact 441sqft 1BR at Whistler Grand, the large 2022 CDL development in D05 West Coast/Clementi, $838K at $1,900 PSF — ~5% below the $1,996 URA median. Cheapest ticket in the batch, deep 233-txn data, but a modest 3.5–3.6%/yr appreciation and no listed MRT proximity make it a yield play.
history.rating_rationale: Highest score in batch (761) reflects clean value-for-data: $838K is the most liquid possible entry, $1,900 PSF is below median, and 233 txns (resale-only 3.5%/yr) give reliable footing. But appreciation is only ~3.5%/yr (OCR-typical, not exciting), no MRT is listed within walking distance for this corner of West Coast, and 441sqft is a shoebox 1BR (niche resale). Large CDL development supports liquidity. Solid income hold, not a growth bet.

history.summary: CDL 716-unit project (99yr, TOP 2022) on West Coast Vale, D5 OCR. The 441 sqft 1BR at $1,900 psf ($838k) is fairly priced (not a deep discount) but D5 is the best forward region and a dated Cross Island Line West Coast station catalyst lands in the hold window.
history.rating_rationale: Web transactions show 441 sqft 1BRs trading $820k-$860k over 2024-2026 (low $820k Sep-24, latest $835k, live listing $860k), so the $838k asking is squarely fair value — the algo's modest -5.1% age-adj premium is accurate, not a bargain. The buy case is region + catalyst, not price: D5 is OCR (realized fwd ~+4.0%, the best of the three regions per v3.4), CDL is a top-tier developer, data is deep and reliable (233 appreciation txns, 18 cohort txns), and the confirmed Cross Island Line Phase 2 'West Coast' station (opening ~2032) directly serves this currently MRT-light pocket — a dated, decisive catalyst landing within a 5-7yr+ hold. Held to Buy (not Strong Buy) because pricing is fair rather than cheap, the 716-unit scale + abundant West Coast Vale supply (Twin Vew, Parc Riviera, Clavon nearby) creates exit competition, and the current 8-min-drive-to-Clementi access is a real present drawback.
red_flags: Asking $838k is mid-range vs verified $820k-$860k recent comps — fairly valued, not cheap (despite the dossier's screen rank)
716-unit project amid heavy West Coast Vale supply (Twin Vew, Parc Riviera, Clavon) — meaningful resale competition on exit
No MRT within walking distance today; the CRL West Coast station only opens ~2032 (uplift is back-loaded)
99-yr leasehold; 1BR investor product competes with a large pool of similar small units
catalysts: Cross Island Line Phase 2 'West Coast' station (~2032) — confirmed government rail catalyst for this MRT-light pocket
D5 is OCR, the strongest realized forward region (~+4.0%) per v3.4 backtest priors
CDL developer quality + large full-facility project supports liquidity; proximity to NUS/one-north/Science Park rental demand
